Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 129. Category: technique. Rank 3.

Rank 3 melee technique
Ki Cost: 30 Ki
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self (45 foot cone)
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Punch the air with the sole purpose of destablizing
targets in front of you.
All targets in range must make a Strength saving
throw or be knocked prone and lose all reactions until
their next turn.
